blocks.text: Sun Life Financial-Philippines Foundation, Inc. (Sun Life Foundation) continues to champion a brighter future for children with the launch of Project SUNBRIGHT Multiplied, extending comprehensive nutrition, caregiving, early learning, and community health support to additional families in Muntinlupa City. As the third phase of its SUNBRIGHT program, Project SUNBRIGHT Multiplied now encompasses Barangay Cupang and Barangay Poblacion alongside the original Barangay Alabang. This expansion is expected to directly support approximately 1,600 residents, including children, pregnant and lactating women, and primary caregivers.
